subject: mathematics
content:
Statement-1 : The point $$A(3, 1, 6)$$ is the mirror image of the point $$B(1, 3, 4)$$ in the plane $$x-y+z=5.$$

Statement-2 : The plane $$x-y+z=5$$ bisects the line segment joining $$A(3, 1, 6)$$ and $$B(1, 3, 4).$$
